description.p: Beifahrer lets an AI agent work in the browser you already use, with your tabs and the sites you are logged into, instead of in a second browser it starts for itself.
Beifahrer lässt einen KI-Agenten in dem Browser arbeiten, den du ohnehin benutzt, mit deinen Tabs und den Seiten, bei denen du angemeldet bist, statt in einem zweiten Browser, den er selbst startet.

ol.li: Your agent asks for something, for example to read the page you are looking at.
Dein Agent fragt nach etwas, zum Beispiel danach, die Seite zu lesen, die du gerade ansiehst.
The Beifahrer app on your computer takes that request. The app is the bridge between your agent and your browser, and it is the only part your agent talks to.
Die Beifahrer-App auf deinem Rechner nimmt diese Anfrage entgegen. Die App ist die Brücke zwischen deinem Agenten und deinem Browser, und nur mit ihr spricht dein Agent.
The Beifahrer extension in your browser checks the request against the rules you set, and refuses anything they do not cover.
Die Beifahrer-Erweiterung in deinem Browser prüft die Anfrage gegen die Regeln, die du gesetzt hast, und lehnt alles ab, was sie nicht abdecken.
The browser carries it out, and you watch it happen.
Der Browser führt sie aus, und du siehst dabei zu.

description.p: Beifahrer sends nothing out. No account, no telemetry, no server on the internet. The app and the extension talk to each other on your own computer and nowhere else.
Beifahrer sendet nichts nach außen. Kein Konto, keine Telemetrie, kein Server im Internet. App und Erweiterung sprechen miteinander auf deinem eigenen Rechner und sonst nirgends.
You say what the agent may do, and you take it back whenever you want:
Du sagst, was der Agent darf, und nimmst es zurück, wann immer du willst:

ul.li: Set each site to None, Read or Edit. On a site you left at None the agent sees the host name and nothing else, not the title and not the rest of the address.
Stelle jede Website auf Nichts, Lesen oder Bearbeiten. Bei einer Website, die auf Nichts steht, sieht der Agent den Hostnamen und sonst nichts, nicht den Titel und nicht den Rest der Adresse.
Need more for a while? Allow all sites for an hour, until the browser closes, or for this one agent session. No temporary access survives a browser restart.

Brauchst du für eine Weile mehr? Gib alle Websites frei, für eine Stunde, bis der Browser schließt oder für diese eine Agenten-Sitzung. Keine befristete Freigabe übersteht einen Neustart des Browsers.
Before a change, Beifahrer asks. A filled field, a click, a closed tab: a window names the site and what is about to happen. On a site you trust you can switch the asking off.

Vor einer Änderung fragt Beifahrer nach. Ein ausgefülltes Feld, ein Klick, ein geschlossener Tab: Ein Fenster nennt die Website und das, was gleich passiert. Bei einer Website, der du traust, kannst du das Nachfragen ausschalten.
Pause stops everything, down to listing your open tabs. Only you start it again, in the extension or with a keyboard shortcut.
Pausieren hält alles an, bis hin zum Auflisten deiner offenen Tabs. Nur du startest wieder, in der Erweiterung oder per Tastenkürzel.
You see the agent at work. The toolbar button changes, a small label with a Stop button appears in the page, and the extension lists what the agent did.

Du siehst den Agenten arbeiten. Das Symbol in der Symbolleiste ändert sich, in der Seite erscheint ein kleines Feld mit einer Stopp-Schaltfläche, und die Erweiterung listet auf, was der Agent getan hat.
What you did not switch on stays off: screenshots, downloads, saved sessions, tab management, the request log, and running the agent's own code in a page.
Was du nicht eingeschaltet hast, bleibt aus: Screenshots, Downloads, gespeicherte Sitzungen, Tabverwaltung, das Anfragenprotokoll und das Ausführen von eigenem Code des Agenten in einer Seite.

description.p: Works in Firefox and in Chromium-based browsers.
Funktioniert in Firefox und in Chromium-basierten Browsern.

ul.li: On a Mac, closing the window now minimises it, so a click on the Dock icon brings it back
Three feature rows (hidden downloads, page requests, file upload) showed a placeholder instead of their icon; fixed
After taking a hidden download, Firefox no longer leaves a tab open on the deleted file
The German app name is now part of the app description
On a Mac, closing the window keeps Beifahrer running; click its Dock icon to bring the window back
On a Mac, the Safari row now shows whether the extension is on instead of staying on Unknown
The app says when a second, outdated pairing file is left over from an earlier version
On a Mac, the app brings the Safari extension along; turn it on in Safari's settings if you want to use Safari
An agent can put a file from a folder you allowed into an upload field on a page
Safari keeps answering after many calls in a row
The toolbar icon in Safari follows light and dark mode once a Beifahrer page opens
In Safari, the options page says where to allow screenshots and hides what Safari cannot do
A simpler toolbar icon that stays recognisable at small sizes
Your default browser comes first when setting up the extension
Firefox installs the extension in Firefox itself, not in whichever browser opens links
The Browser page shows for each browser whether the extension is installed and connected
Connection diagram: every name centred under its picture, all on one line
"This app" label easier to read in dark mode
Toolbar button in the browser's icon colour in Chrome and Edge too
Toolbar button in the same colour as the browser's other icons, on light and dark toolbars
Connection diagram moved from the extension popup to its settings page; the popup is compact again
Toolbar button without a badge: the bus stays fully visible, a coloured dot shows the state
Extension popup and settings work again in Firefox: settings link, connection diagram, all sections
Settings page shows the coloured app icon and working privacy and legal notice links
Status page reads the status text first, with more space around the diagram
Connection diagram on the status page: shows the agent, Beifahrer and the browser, with link states and fix hints
Popup diagram for the extension, with a coloured app icon in the header
Autostart refusal is now reported instead of being saved silently
One app per system: the window and the command line for coding agents are in the same package
Setup assistant in the window: pick your coding agent, review the change to its config and confirm it; the old file is backed up first
The macOS app and the Windows installer no longer collide with a second Beifahrer package
The macOS app is signed and notarised and comes as a disk image
The site links to the developer
The About window links to the privacy policy and the legal notice
Reading a page works again after the first call in the same tab
Long warnings and row titles in the extension wrap instead of being cut off
The desktop app now also runs on Windows and macOS
Agents can download a file a page links to and see whether it finished
Clicking a file link downloads it once instead of twice
New app and extension icon: a VW bus instead of the sparkles
About dialog with a Support link
Scripts get their own switch in the per-site policy, and you can stop script prompts
New beifahrer doctor command to check the setup
Desktop app: Browser and Agent pages with the pairing token and connect snippet
